description: Land Acquisition - Tellipalai South-West, Welikamum North D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire a particular piece of land (including details about the property, location, and purpose) for constructing a Grama Niladhari Office. The content focuses entirely on land acquisition procedures, property description, and compensation claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
